gloss: bushido; the way of the samurai

definitions.gloss: bushido; the way of the warrior; the samurai code of conduct
definitions.explanation: The moral code and ethical principles of the samurai class in feudal Japan, emphasizing loyalty, honor, discipline, and self-sacrifice. Also used in modern Japanese to refer to a spirit of fairness and integrity.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The concept of {武士道|ぶしどう} was codified and popularized through {新渡戸稲造|にとべいなぞう}'s 1900 book 'Bushido: The Soul of Japan,' written in English for a Western audience. Key virtues include {義|ぎ} (righteousness), {勇|ゆう} (courage), ⟦{仁|じん}→仁：23044_jin⟧ (benevolence), ⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧ (respect), ⟦{誠|まこと}→誠：27623_makoto⟧ (honesty), ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧ (honor), and ⟦{忠義|ちゅうぎ}→忠義：20670_chuugi⟧ (loyalty).

In modern usage, {武士道|ぶしどう}⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (bushido spirit) is invoked to describe fair play, perseverance, and integrity, often in sports and business.
